| | Antidepressants | “Antidepressants: primary type of medicine used to treat and prevent depression.” – Cleveland Clinic | “Antidepressants can help manage feelings of sadness and hopelessness.” – Mayo Clinic |
| | Family therapy | “Family therapy” is listed as a type of psychotherapy. – Cleveland Clinic | “Family or group therapy” is listed under talk therapy. – Mayo Clinic |
